MANTLE.Action.impairedHint: Stacks of Impaired, each costing one die.
MANTLE.Action.noTrainedSkills: No trained skills yet. Train them on the Skills tab.
MANTLE.Action.rollHint: Click to make an action roll
MANTLE.Action.situationalHint: Anything else the GM calls for, bonus or penalty.
MANTLE.Action.title: Action Roll
MANTLE.Adversary.autoSuccessHint: A Grunt never rolls: every action roll it makes counts as exactly one success.
MANTLE.Adversary.economyHint: Turns taken per round, and extra maneuvers in each. Enemies track no Vigor and have no reactions by default.
MANTLE.Adversary.noManeuvers: No maneuvers on this stat block.
MANTLE.Adversary.readsPatternsHint: Champions and Nemeses read patterns on their action rolls; Solid Hit applies.
MANTLE.Adversary.resetHint: Restore Vitality and Guard, clear Strain, and remove every Wound and Burden.
MANTLE.Adversary.telegraphedHint: Announced on one turn and resolved at the start of the next.
MANTLE.Adversary.templateIgnored: This stat block is not authored at Regular, so a class template does not apply to it. Run it as written.
MANTLE.Adversary.woundHere: Take a Wound at this location
MANTLE.Attack.coverHint: A target behind cover cannot have its Mass targeted by a ranged attack — only Edge or Mark. Melee ignores cover.
MANTLE.Attack.distanceHint: Squares to the target. Measured from the canvas when you have a token targeted; leave blank to skip range entirely.
MANTLE.Attack.frenzyHint: +1d per stack on melee attacks, reactive attacks included.
MANTLE.Attack.hidden: You are hidden from the target
MANTLE.Attack.hiddenHint: +2d when attacking from hiding. You stop being hidden once the attack resolves.
MANTLE.Attack.title: Attack — {weapon}
MANTLE.Card.addHint: Add a success — a Heroic Feat costs 1 Valor each, up to 3.
MANTLE.Card.applyHint: Apply this result to every token you have targeted. Guard, resistance, and weakness are worked out per target.
MANTLE.Card.desperateHint: The pool fell to zero or below: roll 2d6 and keep the lowest. Patterns do not apply.
MANTLE.Card.graze: Graze — the weakest band, but rarely nothing at all.
MANTLE.Card.noTargets: No targets. Target a token first — targeting, not selecting.
MANTLE.Card.nothingToApply: This result has no number to apply.
MANTLE.Card.subtractHint: Subtract a success — opposition rolls, or GM adjudication.
MANTLE.Cast.needBoth: Casting needs at least one Art and one Resonance. A spell is always both.
MANTLE.Cast.noPairing: {resonance} cannot be cast with {art} — that pairing is not on the Resonance's list.
MANTLE.Cast.noValidPairings: None of this character's Resonances support any of their Arts, so there is nothing to cast.
MANTLE.Cast.notACaster: This character has no spellcasting. It comes from a path archetype such as Scholar or Channeler.
MANTLE.Cast.notEnoughVigor: Not enough Vigor — this cast costs {cost}.
MANTLE.Cast.nothingChosen: No Art and Resonance were chosen, so there is nothing to cast.
MANTLE.Cast.pairingHint: Only combinations the Resonance supports are listed. An Art it does not list cannot be cast with it at any price.
MANTLE.Cast.specialSizeHint: The N in Salvo N, Cone N, or Wall N.
MANTLE.Cast.subtitle: {cost} Vigor
MANTLE.Cast.title: Cast a Spell
MANTLE.Condition.endOfTurnHint: Resolve Wracked damage, auto-clears, roll-to-clears, and the Faltering and Unraveling checks.
MANTLE.Condition.vulnerableMultiTarget: Vulnerable applies to a single target. Roll separately against each, or apply the bonus by hand.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.broken: No maneuvers or reactions, except the free Move on your turn. Auto-clear.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.cursed: Testing your luck always results in 0 successes. Persistent.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.defeated: Out of the combat. Vitality is set to 0 and Faltering is cleared. Persistent.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.exhausted: Refresh only half your Vigor each turn, minimum 1. Roll to clear (POW).
MANTLE.ConditionHint.faltering: At end of turn, roll 1d6: below your stacks and you are Defeated, otherwise the stack grows. Persistent, uncapped.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.frenzy: +1d per stack on melee weapon attacks, and a flat +1 Vigor refresh and +1 SPD. No Brace, no reactive defenses. Take Strain equal to your stacks at end of turn. Cleared by Steady Yourself.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.frightened: You cannot move toward or melee the source. Roll to clear (PRE).
MANTLE.ConditionHint.hindered: SPD halved, -1d on attacks, +1d to attacks against you. No Shift, no Dodge. Roll to clear (POW or AGI).
MANTLE.ConditionHint.impaired: -1d per stack on all rolls except testing your luck. Auto-clear.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.invisible: Always hidden to all other combatants. Anything able to locate invisible creatures treats you as obscured instead. Persistent.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.lost: Your will is not your own. Strain resets to 0 and Unraveling is cleared. Persistent.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.provoked: -2d on attacks and other hostile action rolls against any target other than your provoker. Rolls that target allies are never penalized. Auto-clear.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.shrouded: Everything beyond 1 square is obscured to you; SEN counts as 1. Roll to clear (INS).
MANTLE.ConditionHint.slowed: You take your turn only after every non-Slowed combatant. Roll to clear (AGI).
MANTLE.ConditionHint.surprised: You are also Slowed and cannot take reactions. Auto-clear.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.unraveling: At end of turn, roll 1d6: below your stacks and you are Lost, otherwise the stack grows. Persistent, uncapped.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.vulnerable: Attacks against you gain +1d per stack. Every stack is spent by the first attack that uses them, whatever it rolls. Persistent, max 3.
MANTLE.ConditionHint.wracked: 2 penetrating damage per stack at end of turn, of the named type, before the stack drops. Auto-clear.
MANTLE.Harm.noBurdenSlots: No Burden slot remaining — the character is Lost.
MANTLE.Harm.noWoundSlots: No Wound slot remaining — the character is Defeated.
MANTLE.Harm.takeBurdenHint: Take a Burden — tests your luck for the severity.
MANTLE.Harm.takeWoundHint: Take a Wound — tests your luck for the severity.
MANTLE.Harm.trackIsDerived: Wounds and Burdens are counted from the sheet, not set on the token. Use the track's + and × controls.
MANTLE.Hint.archetypeLimitBreak: Archetype Limit Breaks unlock when the archetype is realized, and carry no attribute prerequisite.
MANTLE.Hint.artLadders: The Resonance decides which ladder a combination resolves on, and supplies its tags and conditions.
MANTLE.Hint.dualType: This weapon deals Slashing or Piercing, chosen per attack — not both at once.
MANTLE.Hint.intrinsic: An intrinsic weapon is part of the body: always equipped, and it costs no gear slot.
MANTLE.Hint.multiSlot: A multi-slot mastery must be paid for entirely within a single board — a 2-slot body mastery cannot take 1 body plus 1 wildcard.
MANTLE.Hint.reach: Leave Melee Reach blank for a weapon that cannot melee, and Max Range blank for one that cannot be thrown or fired.
MANTLE.Item.useConsumableHint: Spend a consumable point on this. Costs 1 Vigor, as the Use Consumable maneuver.
MANTLE.Item.useHint: Use this — posts what it does to chat and spends whatever it costs.
MANTLE.Item.useLimitBreakHint: Perform this Limit Break. Costs 3 Valor, or nothing while in Crisis.
MANTLE.LimitBreak.cannotAfford: A Limit Break costs {cost} Valor and the party has {valor}. Being in Crisis would let you take one for free.
MANTLE.LimitBreak.noneEquipped: No Limit Breaks equipped. Equip one on the Build tab first.
MANTLE.LimitBreak.routeCrisis: Free — in Crisis, become Exhausted (once per combat)
MANTLE.Maneuver.cannotSurge: A character with MIND 0 cannot Surge.
MANTLE.Maneuver.freeMove: The first Move each turn is free.
MANTLE.Maneuver.fullTurn: Full turn — no other maneuvers or reactions until your next turn, except your free Move.
MANTLE.Maneuver.hint: Every combatant can take these. Vigor comes off when you press one; where you moved and what you hid behind stay yours.
MANTLE.Maneuver.nothingToShake: Nothing to shake off — no Hindered or Exhausted.
MANTLE.Maneuver.surgePrompt: Vigor to gain (max {max}), at 2 Strain each
MANTLE.Maneuver.title: Maneuvers
MANTLE.Party.addHint: Add the characters whose tokens are currently selected.
MANTLE.Party.capHint: Max Valor is the sum of every member's SOUL, plus one per member.
MANTLE.Party.noMembers: No members yet. Select their tokens and press +.
MANTLE.Party.selectCharacters: Select one or more character tokens first.
MANTLE.Reaction.braceEffect: Resistance to the triggering attack, and you are now Broken. Resistance does not reduce Strain.
MANTLE.Reaction.braceHint: Free: gain resistance to one incoming attack and become Broken. A last resort.
MANTLE.Reaction.counterattackHint: You are targeted by a melee attack: attack back for 2 Vigor, then take the hit in full.
MANTLE.Reaction.deflectHint: Oppose a melee attack with this weapon for 1 Vigor.
MANTLE.Reaction.dodgeHint: Oppose an attack with AGI for 2 Vigor.
MANTLE.Reaction.forestallHint: A combatant in reach of this Reflexive weapon tries to move: attack them for 2 Vigor.
MANTLE.Reaction.interceptHint: A combatant moves into reach of this melee weapon: attack them for 2 Vigor.
MANTLE.Reaction.noDeflectWeapon: No equipped weapon has the Deflect or Shield tag.
MANTLE.Reaction.noReflexiveWeapon: No equipped melee weapon has the Reflexive tag.
MANTLE.Rest.beginCombatHint: Faltering and Unraveling were paused, not cleared. Anyone still carrying a Critical Wound or a Breakdown re-enters at one stack.
MANTLE.Rest.downtimeHint: The rest between missions. Everything comes back, Wounds and Burdens heal, and the party's Valor resets to zero.
MANTLE.Rest.healAllHint: Heal all {count} Wounds and Burdens? Answer no to keep any the story has anchored — a cursed Wound, a magic-bound Burden.
MANTLE.Rest.interludeHint: The pause between encounters. Restores Vigor, Guard and Strain, clears the fight's conditions, restocks a consumable, and offers each character their Resolve spends.
MANTLE.Rest.title: Rest
MANTLE.Rest.vitalityHint: Vitality is {vitality}/{max}. Spend 1 Resolve of {resolve} to restore it fully?
MANTLE.Sheet.cycleBoardHint: Click to move this mastery between its own board and a wildcard slot.
MANTLE.Sheet.dropArchetype: Drop an ancestry and one or more path archetypes here.
MANTLE.Sheet.dropMastery: Drop masteries here to fill your boards.
MANTLE.Sheet.intrinsicHint: Always available. Costs no gear slot and cannot be unequipped.
MANTLE.Sheet.multiSlotHint: Multi-slot masteries must be paid for entirely within one board.
MANTLE.Sheet.noArmor: No armor. You are in plain clothes — no damage mitigation.
MANTLE.Sheet.noConsumables: No consumables listed. Common consumables are always available.
MANTLE.Sheet.noFoci: No spell focus. Casting without one takes a -1d penalty.
MANTLE.Sheet.noSupportedArts: No Arts supported. This Resonance cannot be cast with anything yet.
MANTLE.Sheet.notACaster: This character has no Arts or Resonances. Spellcasting comes from a path archetype such as Scholar or Channeler.
MANTLE.Sheet.refreshTurnHint: Regain Vigor and restore Guard to its maximum. Over-Guard is left untouched.
MANTLE.Sheet.skillHint: A trained skill adds +2d to an action roll — at most one skill per roll, and never to an attack.
MANTLE.Sheet.testLuckHint: A LUCK roll that takes no modifiers of any kind.
MANTLE.Sheet.vigorRefreshHint: Vigor regained at the start of each of your turns.
MANTLE.Targeting.outOfReach: the target is out of the weapon's reach
MANTLE.Template.aimHint: Scroll to aim, Shift-scroll for a finer turn. Click to confirm, right-click to cancel.
MANTLE.Template.emanationNote: The caster is the centre of an emanation and is not caught by it.
MANTLE.Template.failed: The spell's area could not be drawn. The spell still resolves — place the template by hand if you need it.
MANTLE.Template.noScene: No scene is active, so there is nowhere to put the spell's area.
MANTLE.Template.noToken: This caster has no token on the scene, so an emanation has no centre.
MANTLE.Template.placeHint: Click to place the area. Scroll to turn it, Shift-scroll for a finer turn. Right-click to cancel.
MANTLE.Template.wallNote: A wall's squares need only be adjacent, not straight — drag the template's squares if it should bend.
MANTLE.Valor.feathHint: A Heroic Feat costs 1 Valor per success added, up to 3 on a single roll. Click once per success.
MANTLE.Valor.gainHint: The party earns Valor for heroism, sacrifice, and defeating Elite or greater foes.
MANTLE.Valor.heroicFeatHint: Spend the party's Valor to add successes to this roll — 1 Valor per success, at most 3 on any one roll.
MANTLE.Valor.meritHint: Entering downtime with Valor at half the cap or better earns the party a merit.
MANTLE.Valor.noHeroicFeat: The party has no Valor to spend, or this roll has already had its three successes.
MANTLE.Warning.equilibriumHint: The spread between your highest and lowest core exceeds 4.
